_README: A fragment, not a policy. build.sh merges the `transports` key of this
file into whatever /etc/containers/policy.json the base image ships,
rather than replacing that file — ublue and Fedora both put entries
there, and clobbering them would silently change how every other pull on
Scope is deliberately one repository. Setting a signedBy requirement as
the global default would break pulls of Flatpak runtimes, toolbox images,
and the base image itself, all of which are unsigned by this key.
